author: GNiendorf
body: #### PR description: Improves LSTs displaced efficiency with three commits: 8604ed608d4a3a02986f98c92af0c12969dbead6: In the T5 duplicate removal, the pixel cross-clean and promotion used delta-R or an r-z table tuned for prompt tracks. They now use shared hits, such that two T5s are duplicates at 5 shared hits with agreeing embeddings or 10 outright. Also, a pixel object deletes a T5 only if it is promoted and owns 4 of its OT hits. Lastly, a T5 failing the r-z tight cut is promoted if its DNN score passes the 93% retention working point. d1ebda67a70244a1090a160e2378ad850e2e8200: The segment dPhiChange window previously assumed a beam-line origin. It is replaced by an origin-free line residual at 0.75 sigma. The triplet pointing constraint is widened, allowing an additional set of triplets to pass with a special label; such triplets are used only in T5s. a2d88dd2240b44d599101b2566f2814e6356ecc8: The anti-prompt dxy veto and the delta-R duplicate clause are removed, the r-z chi2 ceilings are loosened, and the cross-clean deletes on shared hits with a promoted candidate (3, or 2 for a pT5) instead of direction. A new cut was also introduced, where each flat-barrel mini-doublet's two-hit direction must agree with the parent triplet's circle tangent within 6 sigma of the strip resolution; computed once per triplet, stored as a flag. c.c @slava77
title: LST: Displaced Efficiency Improvements
